reviews.text: Some people have a natural affinity for animals and know how to win them over instantly; Anne Laure has this gift! Even with slightly challenging animals, she knows how to connect with them and build a trusting relationship that puts them at ease. In short, a gem for looking after our furry friends, thank you Anne Laure!

Anne-Laure has been Scotty's pet sitter since we moved to Lyon. We trust her completely! Scotty adores her and feels very comfortable with her, even though he's a timid cat. Anne-Laure is incredibly professional, sending us daily photos to keep us updated on our cat. She takes excellent care of animals and adapts to each cat's individual needs. She's our go-to pet sitter! Thank you again for everything.

Our cat and we are so lucky to have found AL to pamper him and reassure us while we're away. She takes excellent care of him, and every day we've had the pleasure of receiving updates and photos. Don't hesitate to entrust your four-legged companions to her!
